source.scope: Complete original type 3 line-grid insertion via 0x42a550/0x42a6e0, original CRT allocation, both endpoints and X/Z traversals. Finite endpoints, zero-length axes, dimensions 1..8, unequal grid origins, empty/prepopulated lists and matching sentinel/neighbor owners. Ordered list owner/auxiliary/active fields and previous-link consistency checked; uninitialized cell-index words excluded. Type 4 and collision dispatch excluded.
